source_boundary: inventory-listed AlgoTune and Multi-SWE-bench only; no excluded collection outcomes read

split.rule: global exact normalized content clusters; stable SHA256 half split
split.algotune_subject_partition: V27-B frozen six held-out subjects only; non-heldout subjects excluded
split.prefix_order: SHA256(prefix, seed, subject_id, item_id), nested per subject
split.response_rule: acquisition: first trial,response_id per item; evaluation: all exact-binary rows retained

category_accuracy_diagnostic.scope: evaluation outcome descriptive only; not used for feature/rule selection
category_accuracy_diagnostic.misclassification_note: No independently annotated gold task taxonomy exists; false-positive/false-negative category error cannot be estimated from outcomes without circularly defining categories.

interpretation_limits: Both sources/results have been used previously in project research; this is retrospective exploratory comparison, not independent confirmation.
Task categories are fixed keyword proxies, not a gold-labeled taxonomy; category error rate is not identifiable without independent annotation.
AlgoTune labels are the published final_speedup threshold; Multi-SWE labels represent issue resolution. Label semantics differ.
No hidden PAIEC evaluation outcomes are accessed. Results are not Codabench scores and do not establish transfer to private benchmarks.
If categories overlap, a revealed item is counted once in local support. Local support is deduplicated by exact observable item payload and conflicting repeated outcomes are excluded.
